author: svaret
title: ReLoading.... when Evermusic not active
content:
I really love this player and have used it for a long time.

Recently, one of the newest versions, a strange behaviour started. When Evermusic is not active, ie what you see on the screen is not Evermusic, the player is not loading when starting to play the coming song. If I then activate Evermusic it starts to play.

I have sent a couple of emails to Evermusic support about this but I haven't received any feedback. The first email was sent a couple of weeks ago. I think that not answering to clients email is a really bad customer service.

However I will continue using it. I love it

Best regards /Lasse

author: Jakob Brönnum
title: Album listener beware
content: The app does not recognize albums from your drive correctly, so if you are an album listener stay away, it is a 100% waste of money. Unfortunately, there is no way of trying out this app before using it.

author: EnDroid
title: Failing while casting to Chromecast audio
content: Great app 4 many of my needs. But it constantly fails in various ways while streaming to Chromecast audio. Often just plays one or two songs in playlist. Also starts playing a song and then in the middle of the song it starts playing in the phone, but really out of sync, maybe even next song in playlist. Great when using with bluetooth devices though.
